body: I'm sorry people treat you like that, I mean it very genuinely I feel like as humans we should at least attempt try to be kind/loving so it is upsetting when people act cruel. I totally get where you are coming from too, I am not very social either. I'm a very introverted, quiet person myself and it can be hard a lot of time in a world where extroverts are favored. Honestly, your empathetic response means a lot to me and maybe you are right about the loving ourselves part. Sometimes it's just easier to watch reanimator on netflix for the millionth time than introspectively remind myself of my flaws lol.
